Every sample carries its EnGeL label from the sample master data file (`ENGEL_master_data`, lab Google Drive): `EnGeL_<year>_<unique code>_<project>_<sample nature>_<type of sampling>`, e.g. EnGeL_24_AAA_SYBER_Raw_Soil. Codes are assigned by the data curator; lab members fill in their own sheet and the curator validates and generates the labels. A sample derived from another (for example a DNA extract) is entered as a new sample with its own unique code and label; the code of the source sample is kept in a separate column.
